findings.description: __aexit__ calls self.__exit__(None, None, None) instead of passing exc_type, exc_value, traceback, so the exception raised in the async with body is discarded.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception is raised inside `async with attempt:`. __exit__ gets None and takes the success path, calling retry_state.set_result(None) and returning None. The failure is recorded as a success, so the retry does not happen and the exception is not recorded in the retry state. The sync __exit__ presumably branches on exc_type to call set_exception and suppress the error, so passing the real arguments is required.
